name: gundarium-model-worker
description: Standalone worker: pops mint jobs off the model-generation queue, runs headless Blender to assemble a GLB from KitbashTraits, uploads it to IPFS, and records the result. Runs wherever Blender is installed (not on Vercel) — currently no host is provisioned for this; run it anywhere with Node 20+ and `blender` on PATH.
